uv-water-filter-ultraviolet-sterilisatio.shortDescription: 6W UV water steriliser with confirmed Philips TUV 6W G6 T5 lamp. Philips lamp data: 1.9W UV-C output at 100 hours, approx. 253.7 nm peak wavelength and 9,000-hour rated useful life. 12V DC system power supply.
uv-water-filter-ultraviolet-sterilisatio.description:
A **6W ultraviolet water steriliser** using the confirmed **Philips TUV 6W G6 T5** germicidal UV-C lamp. This version uses a **12V DC system power supply / ballast**. The lamp itself is the same lamp used in the 220–240V AC version.

## UV Lamp

- **Lamp manufacturer:** Philips / Signify
- **Lamp model:** Philips TUV 6W G6 T5
- **Philips / Signify product code:** 928000704013
- **Lamp type:** T5 germicidal UV-C lamp
- **Lamp power:** 6W
- **UV-C output:** 1.9W at 100 hours
- **Peak UV-C wavelength:** approximately 253.7 nm (254 nm)
- **Nominal lamp voltage:** 42V
- **Nominal lamp current:** 0.16A
- **Rated useful life:** 9,000 hours
- **Base:** G5
- **Lamp format:** T5
- **Replacement lamp:** Philips TUV 6W G6 T5 / Signify 928000704013

**Important:** 1.9W is the lamp's UV-C radiant output at 100 hours, not its electrical power consumption. Lamp wattage and UV-C output do not establish a reactor dose in mJ/cm².

## UV Reactor / System Specifications

- **System power supply / ballast:** 12V DC
- **Reactor flow:** 1 GPM
- **UV chamber:** stainless steel

No UV dose-at-flow claim is inferred from the Philips lamp data.

uv-0-5-1-gpm-11w-filters-uv-water-steril.shortDescription: 11W UV water steriliser kit with Philips TUV 11W UV-C lamp, stainless steel chamber, quartz sleeve and 200–240V AC electronic ballast. Australian plug and fittings included.
uv-0-5-1-gpm-11w-filters-uv-water-steril.description:
An **11W UV water steriliser kit** for appropriately pre-filtered point-of-use water systems. Includes a **Philips TUV 11W UV-C lamp** within a stainless steel treatment chamber.

## What's included
- Philips TUV 11W UV-C lamp
- Stainless steel UV chamber
- Quartz glass lamp sleeve
- 11W electronic ballast with Australian mains plug and lamp connector
- Two push-fit elbow fittings
- Two mounting clips

## Technical details
- **UV lamp:** Philips TUV 11W
- **Power input:** 200–240V AC, 50/60Hz (pictured ballast label)
- **Connection fittings:** Two push-fit elbows supplied; thread and tubing dimensions require confirmation
- **Flow:** Previously advertised as 0.5–1 GPM; UV dose at that flow has not been verified.

## Important installation information
Water quality, UV transmittance, flow rate and lamp condition affect UV treatment performance. Pre-filtration may be necessary to reduce turbidity and fouling. The 11W lamp rating and advertised flow range do not establish a particular UV dose or pathogen reduction. UV treatment does not remove dissolved contaminants or provide residual protection. Confirm suitability for the water source and applicable standards before installation.

**WaterMark:** Certification status and applicability have not been independently verified. Confirm plumbing requirements for the intended installation. **UV safety:** Never view or energise an exposed UV-C lamp; direct UV-C can injure eyes and skin.
